profile.intro: I am a physics graduate student at the University of Chittagong with interests in quantum information, quantum communication, quantum simulation, and quantum technologies.

about.who: I am currently pursuing an M.Sc. in Physics at the University of Chittagong.
about.what: My interests center on quantum information science, quantum computing, quantum communication, and computational approaches to physics.
about.going: I aim to develop deeper research experience in quantum technologies and pursue advanced academic research.

projects.title: Quantum Simulation of Open Quantum Systems
projects.organization: The Abdus Salam International Centre for Theoretical Physics (ICTP) — Physics Without Frontiers
projects.mentorRole: Postdoctoral Researcher, North Carolina State University, USA
projects.description: A research project focused on the quantum simulation of open quantum systems, exploring the intersection of quantum computing and theoretical physics.
details: Study the theoretical foundations of open quantum systems and quantum simulation.
Explore computational approaches for simulating dissipative quantum dynamics.
Develop understanding of quantum-information and quantum-computing methods relevant to open-system problems.
Connect theoretical models with practical quantum-simulation workflows.
